description: This file contains the implementation of Smarty internal compilation classes for {for}, {forelse}, and {/for} tags, which handle the compilation of these template control structures in the Smarty template engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_For

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Forelse
classes.description: Handles compilation of {forelse} tags, managing the else-part of loops.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Forclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of {/for} closing tags in Smarty templates.
